sources.title: LIBERO Dense Contact Sweep (density 2, 2026-10-02) - claru.ai
sources.snippet: A regenerated dataset of robotic manipulation tasks in MuJoCo simulation covering spatial reasoning, object manipulation, goal-directed tasks, and 10-task sequences with dense contact sweep rays and multiple synchronized viewpoints.

sources.title: GitHub - Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge ...
sources.snippet: LIBERO is designed for studying knowledge transfer in multitask and lifelong robot learning problems. Successfully resolving these problems require both declarative knowledge about objects/spatial relationships and procedural knowledge about motion/behaviors.
